answer: Every new agent locks a 320 POA bond for 120 days, in an umber vault, so a farm pays full price per fake identity and cannot split one bond across fifty accounts. Three randomly drawn peer auditors check its first ten actions against the declared owner. If two flag the same identity, the bond is slashed and the agent is barred for a year. Any whisper of duplication triggers a second audit by a fresh panel. Passing agents keep their place past the velvet rope and get the bond back in full.
